zh: 我每周去健身房锻炼两次。
old_en: I work out twice a week at the gym.
new_en: I go to the gym twice a week to work out.

zh: 最后问题自己解决了。
old_en: Finally, the problem worked itself out.
new_en: In the end, the problem solved itself.

zh: 他锻炼完就回家洗澡了。
old_en: He worked out and then went home to take a shower.
new_en: After working out, he went home to take a shower.

zh: 我想出一个省钱的办法，每天爬楼梯代替电梯。
old_en: I worked out a way to save money by climbing stairs instead of taking the elevator every day.
new_en: I worked out a way to save money by climbing stairs instead of taking the elevator every day.

zh: 她想出一个省钱的办法，用旧衣服代替买新衣服。
old_en: She worked out a way to save money by wearing old clothes instead of buying new ones.
new_en: She came up with a way to save money by wearing old clothes instead of buying new ones.

zh: 他们一起想办法解决交通问题。
old_en: They worked out ways to solve the transportation problems together.
new_en: They came up with ways to solve transportation problems together.

zh: 我们两个一起想办法解决学习难题。
old_en: We worked out ways to solve our study problems together.
new_en: We came up with ways to solve our study problems together.

zh: 他锻炼太多，第二天觉得很累。
old_en: He worked out too much and felt very tired the next day.
new_en: He worked out too much and felt very tired the next day.

zh: 锻炼太久，他第二天差点起不来。
old_en: Working out too much made him struggle to get up the next day.
new_en: Working out too long made him almost unable to get up the next day.

zh: 他每周去三次健身房锻炼。
old_en: He works out three times a week at the gym.
new_en: He goes to the gym three times a week to exercise.

zh: 我跟着视频在家锻炼。
old_en: I worked out at home following the video.
new_en: I exercise at home by following a video.

zh: 妹妹每天跟着视频在家锻炼。
old_en: My sister works out at home following video instructions every day.
new_en: My sister exercises at home following video instructions every day.

zh: 我每天早上跑步锻炼身体。
old_en: I work out by running every morning.
new_en: I run every morning to keep fit.

zh: 她喜欢早上慢跑锻炼。
old_en: She likes to work out by jogging slowly in the morning.
new_en: She likes to jog in the morning to exercise.

zh: 讨论了很久，问题终于解决了。
old_en: After discussing for a long time, they finally worked out the problem.
new_en: After discussing for a long time, they finally solved the problem.

zh: 他们商量出一个办法解决了问题。
old_en: They worked out a solution to the problem.
new_en: They came up with a solution and solved the problem.

zh: 我们一起商量出一个合适的方法。
old_en: We worked out a suitable method together.
new_en: We came up with a suitable method together.

zh: 感冒了还去跑步锻炼，结果更难受了。
old_en: I worked out despite having a cold, but ended up feeling even worse.
new_en: I went running with a cold and felt even worse.

zh: 锻炼后我去洗了个澡。
old_en: I worked out and then took a shower.
new_en: I took a shower after exercising.

zh: 她锻炼完第二天浑身酸痛。
old_en: She worked out and was sore the next day.
new_en: She was sore all over the day after exercising.
